verdict.rationale: Alloy is a SaaS identity and fraud platform that runs its own machine learning model (Fraud Signal), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting, policy, or contractual control that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. Sandbox mode is an adjacent feature and does not address training use; Alloy states that sandbox and production records share one data store with no data boundary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
